نبذة

Chi Nail Spa has created a place in Dubai consisting of the ultimate tranquility to heal and nurture the mind, body, and soul. Chi Nail Spa has been designed with you in mind, to offer you comfort in an oasis of calm and serenity, supplying customers with the latest cutting edge Nail treatments and products today and every day. Treat yourself to the very best at Chi Nail Spa, you will get personal and friendly service from fully trained, experienced nail technicians. Relax in our clean and hygienic environment while we pamper you. Your comfort and satisfaction are our top priority.

For a change from a standard nail appointment, Chi Nail Spa Saloon L.L.C- JVT pairs manicures and pedicures with services such as waxing, massage, and eyebrow threading. Reviews mention carefully applied gel polish, French manicures for hands and toes, and brow mapping for symmetrical results.
